reference_type: Blinded two-clinician-adjudicated reference set; exploratory conditional agreement only
definition: Seven frozen features: any AP code, principal AP code, enzyme >=3xULN, normalized log maximum ULN multiple, pain flag, imaging flag, and pancreatitis-history flag; C=1.0, balanced classes, threshold 0.50
intended_use: Excluded from main empirical comparison because event-per-feature support and inferential uncertainty were inadequate; specification retained for transparency
not_for: Main clinical comparison or clinical deployment
